# Endovenous Ablation — Authorization Guide

## CPT Codes — Endovenous Ablation

| CPT | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 36475 | Endovenous ablation therapy of incompetent vein, extremity, inclusive of all imaging guidance and monitoring, percutaneous, radiofrequency; first vein treated |
| 36476 | Endovenous ablation, radiofrequency; second and subsequent veins treated in a single extremity, each through separate access sites |
| 36478 | Endovenous ablation therapy, laser; first vein treated |
| 36479 | Endovenous ablation, laser; second and subsequent veins treated in a single extremity |
| 36482 | Endovenous ablation therapy, mechanochemical (MOCA); first vein treated |
| 36483 | Endovenous ablation, mechanochemical; second and subsequent veins |
| 93971 | Duplex scan of extremity veins, unilateral (pre-procedure mapping) |

## ICD-10 Diagnosis Codes

| ICD-10 | Description |
| --- | --- |
| I83.001 | Varicose veins of right lower extremity with ulcer of thigh |
| I83.009 | Varicose veins of right lower extremity with ulcer of unspecified site |
| I83.10 | Varicose veins of unspecified lower extremity with inflammation |
| I83.209 | Varicose veins of unspecified lower extremity with both ulcer and inflammation |
| I83.811 | Varicose veins of right lower extremity with pain |
| I83.812 | Varicose veins of left lower extremity with pain |
| I83.891 | Varicose veins of right lower extremity with other complications |
| I83.90 | Asymptomatic varicose veins of unspecified lower extremity |
| I87.2 | Venous insufficiency (chronic) (peripheral) |
| I87.301 | Chronic venous hypertension (idiopathic) with ulcer of right lower extremity |

## Standard Payer Requirements

### Universal Requirements (Most Payers)

- CEAP classification C2 or higher (symptomatic varicose veins or higher)
- Duplex ultrasound confirming truncal vein (GSV or SSV) reflux ≥0.5 seconds in standing position
- Graduated compression stocking trial ≥6 weeks (20–30 mmHg) with documented compliance and failure
- Symptoms attributable to venous insufficiency (pain, heaviness, swelling, skin changes)
- Procedure performed by qualified physician in accredited facility

### Medicare (CMS LCD L35000 / A56648)

- CEAP C2–C6 with documented symptoms
- Duplex-confirmed reflux ≥0.5s (GSV) or ≥1.0s (SSV) in standing position
- Compression stocking trial ≥12 weeks for C2–C3; may be waived for C4–C6
- Vein diameter ≥2 mm on duplex (most LCDs)
- Medical necessity documentation including VCSS score

### Commercial Payers (Aetna, BCBS, UHC, Cigna)

- Most require 3–6 week compression trial; some require 12 weeks
- VCSS ≥7 or CEAP C3+ often required for expedited authorization
- Active venous ulcer (C6) may qualify without compression trial
- Bilateral procedures may require separate authorizations
- Aetna: Requires CEAP C2+ with symptoms AND duplex-confirmed reflux; C1 not covered

### Documentation Checklist

- Duplex ultrasound report with reflux duration, vein diameter, and standing protocol
- CEAP classification and VCSS score documented in office note
- Compression stocking prescription and compliance documentation
- Photographs of varicosities and/or skin changes
- Failed conservative therapy documentation (dates, duration, compliance)
